title: WorldCore: Important Systems
summary: Read the WorldCore signals, states, and failure clues that matter in play.

blocks.title: What To Watch
blocks.body: Regions, hazards, active snapshots, and discovery progress all shape what the player sees and when. Treat each warning as a preparation clue.

blocks.title: Player Signals
blocks.body: Watch region names, hazard snapshots, active conditions, biome or structure context, discovery progress, and whether a warning is preparation advice.

blocks.title: Keep It Legible
blocks.body: A WorldCore system is working when another player could look at the state, understand the next action, and avoid the obvious failure.

blocks.title: State Check
blocks.body: Use the system note to read the current state, then choose one action that answers it.
